title: Entity
description: Any named thing the engine tracks that is not itself an investable asset: a place, an organisation or a person. Towns, resorts, operators, managers, inspectors and developers are all entities. Domains specialise via entity_type and attributes.

entity_type.description: Domain-defined, e.g. market, submarket, operator, service_provider, professional, developer, authority.

parent_entity_id.description: Enables the market hierarchy: country > region > market > submarket. A region is never treated as a single market.

administrative_codes.description: Official codes enabling joins to government statistics, e.g. municipality code.

attributes.description: Domain-defined attributes. Core does not interpret these; the domain module does.
